title: add RAG agent quickstart, RAG templates, and tool-calling examples; update docs site
author: Priya Shah
description: Add a developer-facing quickstart and example suite for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent/tool-calling patterns. This PR introduces: 1) a step-by-step RAG quickstart (docs/quickstarts/rag-quickstart.md) that covers chunking, vector store ingestion (we show examples with FAISS and Pinecone), prompt templates, and evaluation guidance; 2) reusable RAG templates (docs/templates/rag-templates.md) with recommended prompt scaffolds and token-budget notes; 3) two agents examples (examples/agents/search-agent and examples/agents/calculator-agent) demonstrating tool-calls and structured outputs with the Redwood API (Python + TypeScript); 4) docs site updates to surface the quickstart under the Getting Started nav and add cross-links to SDK examples; and 5) CI smoke tests for the examples and a minimal end-to-end RAG integration test using a small fixture dataset. Motivation: incoming customer requests and internal adoption showed repeated copy/paste gaps for building RAG + agent flows; having curated templates and runnable examples will reduce onboarding time and prevent common mistakes (incorrect chunk sizes, missing metadata for embeddings, improper tool call validation). Checklist: - [x] Quickstart guide and templates - [x] Python + TypeScript example apps - [x] Docs site nav + sidebar updates - [x] Example CI smoke tests - [x] Inline SDK snippet updates for redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript - [x] Add note about model and quantization compatibility (recommended models and sequence lengths) Compatibility notes: Examples tested against Redwood API spec v1.8.0 and runtime v2.2.0; vector store adapters use lightweight local FAISS binary for CI and have Pinecone integration documented for production. No breaking API changes. Follow-ups: track ENG-2754 to add a managed vector-store connector in Dedicated mode and ENG-2761 for extended evals on larger datasets.
